description:
Create and store a custom component for the tenant: a native scene that arranges its declared images and videos as tiles in 3D space. Returns the ComponentResponse (id + metadata) you can then reference from a composition. No project arg — components are tenant-scoped. SOURCE CONTRACT (version 4; the server instructions' Component Contract has the full rules and an example): send the complete source object {version:4, componentId, template, manifest, definition}. `template` is one sub-composition: a root
holding
, and one inline script ending in __cfScene.mount({ root: document.getElementById('root'), component, variables: __hyperframes.getVariables() }). data-composition-variables is the definition's projection (scalar inputSchema properties, then manifest slots). The manifest is {version:4, runtime:'hyperframes', hfContract:1, kind:'scene', assets, graphics:{api:'webgl2',…}, alphaPolicy}; slots are image or video. The source is admitted before it is stored: template lint, determinism (no timers, Date, network or CSS animation) and the declaration are checked, and a refusal names the rule. A version-3 source is retired and refused as component_source_retired. Place it with execution {version:4, componentId, sourceVersionId, params, seed, assets:{ slot: mediaId }} and placement {version:3, kind:'clip'}; slots never travel in params.

body.description: POST /components body. Org/user are server-resolved; never accepted from the body.

componentId.description: Caller-chosen stable component id. On create it names the new component. On PUT/PATCH it is optional and, when present, must equal the id in the path; a mismatch is a 400 naming both.

examples.description: Usage examples, as authored. A built-in primitive projects {name, mood?, params?, description?}; an authored component's examples are whatever it wrote, which is why the item is open. One shape for both directions: what you write here is what you read back.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: create_component

avoidWith.description: Authoring guidance: ids of primitives that CONFLICT with this one — do not place together.

brandBindings.description: Params that can follow the project brand kit. Each {param, brandToken} says: set `param` to `brandToken` (a `$brand:` ref, e.g. '$brand:colors.accent') to track the brand instead of a literal. See the list response's `brandTokens` for the full ref vocabulary. Omitted when nothing is brand-bound.

examples.description: Usage examples, as authored. A built-in primitive projects {name, mood?, params?, description?}; an authored component's examples are whatever it wrote, which is why the item is open. One shape for both directions: what you write here is what you read back.

fixedCopy.description: On-screen strings this primitive BAKES — the read-side counterpart to propSchema. These literals render REGARDLESS of params (no param can change them); fork the source via get_component_source to edit them. Use this to see at author time what fixed copy (someone-else's marketing text, faux-code, faux-data) will appear before you render.

id.description: The entry's id: a `primitiveId` for a built-in, a `componentId` for an installed component.

intent.description: Selection signal: a verb naming what this primitive accomplishes (e.g. 'product-trailer'). Match it to the beat you are authoring.

kind.description: RENDER kind (component | transition | scene). NOT the ClipSource variant — see `placement` for how to author it on the timeline.

mood.description: Vibe/tone tags (e.g. 'cinematic', 'minimal'). Filter to match the edit's mood.

pairsWith.description: Authoring guidance: ids of primitives that COMPOSE well with this one in the same edit.

source.description: 'default' = built-in primitive (place by primitiveId); 'installed' = org-authored component (place by componentId).

subtextParam.description: The param field for secondary text (subtitle/byline); null = none.

textParam.description: The param field that carries this primitive's primary text; null = no single text slot.

tier.description: Quality/applicability RANKING (a preference, not a flag). Prefer 'recommended'; reach for 'niche' only when its specific use-case is exactly the beat.

useCase.description: The edit ROLE(s) this primitive fills — the dimension to filter by for a beat (e.g. 'intro', 'title-over-footage', 'grade').

useWhen.description: When to use this — AND when not to. The negative guidance is load-bearing; read it before picking.

version.description: The ENTRY's version: a semver string ('0.0.0' until an authored component is versioned). Distinct from `manifest.version`, which is the runtime contract version (4 native, 2 retired TSX).

warnings.description: Non-blocking save-time advisories — the create/update SUCCEEDED. Currently: a `fontFamily` string literal referencing a NON-vendored font (a bare CSS generic like 'serif', or an unknown named family like 'Arial') whose LIVE-lane pixels vary by render host — re-author with a vendored family or 'Georgia'. Omitted when there is nothing to flag; only present on the create/update responses.
